name: android-small
description: Android-style expenses app (Material 3) — small test copy of a synthetic screen recording with exact ground truth (rendered frame by frame from a virtual clock)

source.note: every other frame of the 30 fps source (frame j here = source frame 2j), scaled; times are unchanged, positions and sizes multiplied by scaleX / scaleY

encoding.video: libx264 (H.264 High), CRF 16, preset veryslow, tune animation, yuv420p, BT.709 limited range
encoding.note: keyframes are forced at 0 s and inside large transitions (the encoder added a few scene-cut keyframes, also inside transitions); none falls inside a still. After decoding, stills are steady except for a few encoder refinement pixels in the frames right after motion stops

conventions.units: times in seconds of the video timeline; positions and sizes in this video's pixels, top-left origin; box = [x, y, width, height]
conventions.frames: frame i shows the app at exactly t = i / fps; every event boundary is a multiple of 1/15 s, so it lands on a frame in both the 30 fps and 15 fps versions
conventions.tap: t = finger down, tUp = finger up; (x, y) = touch point; box = the touched control. Press feedback (highlight, dim, ripple, key callout) appears in the frame at t unless the event says otherwise
conventions.toggle: a tap whose result is a local state change; has the tap fields plus t0..t1, the span of the whole animation
conventions.type: t0 = first key down, t1 = last character appears; box = text field, keyboard = keyboard or keypad; keys[] = each key press (t, tUp, key box); chars[] = field text after each key up
conventions.scroll: content moves by (dx, dy) px between t0 and t1 (negative dy = content moves up, i.e. the user scrolls down); box = scrolling viewport; touch = finger path (down at t0, lifts at tUp, momentum carries on to t1)
conventions.screen: a screen transition (push, pop, sheet, sheet-dismiss, tab, tab-swipe, container-transform, dialog, dialog-dismiss); motion runs from t0 to t1 and the frame at t1 shows the settled screen
conventions.change: an in-place content animation that is not a screen change (row inserted or removed, snackbar)
conventions.still: frames with t0 <= t < t1 are pixel-identical; caretBlink = only a blinking text caret inside caretBox changes

events.note: finger drags the pager left (content follows it exactly), releases half way and the page settles; the tab indicator slides from Overview to Activity

events.response: ripple, then the FAB grows into the New expense screen

nothing moves except the blinking caret after the amount
in-app number pad; each key shows a ripple; the digit appears at key up
ripple, then the chip fills and a check icon slides in (the chips after it move right)
nothing moves except the blinking caret after the amount

events.response: ripple, then the screen shrinks back into the FAB

new row "Coffee beans −$18.75" opens up under "Today" with a mint highlight that then fades; the rows below move down
fling; the top app bar takes its scrolled colour and the extended FAB collapses to an icon button during the scroll

events.response: ripple from the touch point, then the detail screen

scrim fades in, dialog scales up from 88% and fades in
